comparison.objective: Refits and phases a splined driveshaft slip yoke; candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Spline alignment, axial sliding, and rotational phasing differ from stabilizing a recessed mandrel, controlled hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Yoke seated to its collar at the required phase after release versus four contact-fractured, contained tangs with all coils and shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Both require coaxial alignment, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes—spline mating/phasing versus notch fracture plus loose-fragment containment—are meaningfully different.
